issues.description: Retries retryable/empty-body 5xx responses for POST requests without idempotency keys, which can duplicate batch task creation or replay reviews.
Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without escaping, so IDs containing '/', ':', '?', or '%' can change the requested route.
Retry-After parsing only supports numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date Retry-After values.
backoff_cap is applied before jitter, so actual sleep duration can exceed the configured cap.
Constructor validates max_attempts only; invalid negative backoff_base/backoff_cap values can produce invalid or negative sleep durations.
Transport/timeouts from httpx are neither retried nor wrapped in the SDK's exception model.
Error.from_dict uses bool() coercion, so a malformed string value like 'false' becomes retryable=True.
BatchItemResult accepts malformed API results without validating status/task/error invariants.
MockLumenServer returns scripted responses before checking the API key, allowing auth regressions to be hidden in tests.
Package does not ship a py.typed marker despite being advertised as a typed client.
Generator pytest fixture is annotated as LumenClient instead of Generator, causing mypy failure.
Test dereferences results[count - 1].task without narrowing Optional, causing mypy failure.
